description: This file defines the 'LangString' class in PHP, which models a language string with properties like unit ID, group ID, value, version, and note. It includes constructor and getter methods, as well as a static factory method to create an instance from an array.

classes.name: LangString
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a language string with metadata in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LangString instance with unit ID, group ID, value, and optional version and note.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID of the language string.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID of the language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value/content of the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the language string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the language string, or null if not set.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a LangString instance from an array containing keys 'unitId', 'groupId', 'value', and optionally 'version' and 'note'.
